flows.title: Score whether the method got better

steps.phrase: ask for a score on the change to the instructions
hand the agent the scoring recipe to follow
type the eval commands the recipe names, over the two maps
route each typed sub-command to the checker that answers it
reduce each map to the numbers two builds can be compared on
read the built map and count what it holds
hand over the doubters' votes and the scorers' marks
fold the votes and the marks into one quality report
steps.note: a doubter who could not check the code counts as a failure, never as a refusal

steps.phrase: list the relations the rebuild dropped while the code still makes them
run one scoring pass over the frozen candidate map
steps.note: refused when the map no longer matches the fingerprint taken at freeze time

steps.phrase: read the accepted map's stored numbers
check the fresh map's numbers against the accepted one's
return the verdict: as good, drifted, or worse
file the fresh map's numbers with the run
print the verdict with the gates and bands that moved
show the verdict and where the run was filed

edges.why: routes the score command to the map profiler
routes the run, hash, claims, judge and bless commands to the run orchestrator
routes the compare command to the baseline comparison
routes the arrows command to the lost-relation check
routes the archive command to the map mover
routes the live-numbers command to the number ledger
routes the mutate command to the planted-falsehood test
profiles the map the run is scoring
compares the fresh map's numbers with the accepted one's and takes the verdict
folds the collected votes and marks into one quality report
reads a built map and counts what it holds
reads the map for the risky claims a doubter must check
reads both maps to match their relations by source file
reads the live maps the tools' sentences state numbers about
moves the built map into the rebuild archive so the next build starts from nothing
reads the accepted map's stored numbers to compare against
writes the scored map's numbers into the run folder
reads two stored number sheets to band them
